verses.word_meanings: sarva-guhyatamam—the most confidential of all secrets; bhūyaḥ—again; śṛṇu—listen; me—to My; paramam vacaḥ—supreme supreme word; iṣṭaḥ asi me—you are dearly beloved to Me; dṛḍham iti—most firmly; tataḥ—therefore; vakṣyāmi—I shall speak; te—for your; hitam—highest good / welfare.
verses.translation: Hear again My supreme word, the most confidential of all secrets. Because you are so dearly beloved to Me, I shall speak for your highest good and eternal welfare.
verses.meaning: The Lord prepares to deliver the crowning verse of the entire Bhagavad Gita, overflowing with infinite divine love and tenderness for His devotee.
verses.purport: The Lord prepares to deliver the crowning verse of the entire Bhagavad Gita, overflowing with infinite divine love and tenderness for His devotee.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु |
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे || ६५ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु |
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे || ६५ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me || 65 ||
verses.word_meanings: mat-manāḥ bhava—absorb your mind in Me; mad-bhaktaḥ—be devoted to Me; mad-yājī—worship Me / sacrifice unto Me; mām namaskuru—bow down to Me; mām eva eṣyasi—you will certainly attain Me; satyam—truly / in absolute truth; te—unto you; pratijāne—I promise / pledge; priyaḥ asi me—you are dear to Me.
verses.translation: Absorb your mind in Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice unto Me, and bow down to Me. Thus you shall certainly attain Me. In truth I promise you, for you are dearly beloved to Me.
verses.meaning: The fourfold practice of pure Bhakti: Constant remembrance (Manmana), love (Madbhakta), offering of actions (Madyaji), and humble surrender (Namaskuru). Krishna seals this with a solemn divine pledge.
verses.purport: The fourfold practice of pure Bhakti: Constant remembrance (Manmana), love (Madbhakta), offering of actions (Madyaji), and humble surrender (Namaskuru). Krishna seals this with a solemn divine pledge.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज |
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः || ६६ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज |
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः || ६६ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja |
ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ || 66 ||
verses.word_meanings: sarva-dharmān—all varieties of religious duties, rites, and obligations; parityajya—relinquishing / transcending; mām ekam—unto Me alone; śaraṇam vraja—take exclusive refuge / surrender; aham—I; tvām—you; sarva-pāpebhyaḥ—from all sins and karmic bondages; mokṣayiṣyāmi—will liberate / deliver; mā śucaḥ—do not grieve / fear not.
verses.translation: Abandoning all varieties of dharmas, take refuge in Me alone. I shall deliver you from all sins and bondages; do not grieve!
verses.meaning: The 'Charama Shloka' (The Ultimate Verse) of the Gita: Transcending all ritualistic and conceptual duties to take unconditional refuge in Bhagavan Sri Krishna. In return, God assumes full responsibility for the soul's liberation.
verses.purport: The 'Charama Shloka' (The Ultimate Verse) of the Gita: Transcending all ritualistic and conceptual duties to take unconditional refuge in Bhagavan Sri Krishna. In return, God assumes full responsibility for the soul's liberation.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन |
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति || ६७ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन |
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति || ६७ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana |
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati || 67 ||
verses.word_meanings: idam—this confidential wisdom; te—by you; na atapaskāya—never to one devoid of austerity; na abhaktāya—never to one who is not a devotee; kadācana—at any time; na ca aśuśrūṣave—nor to one who has no desire to listen/serve; vācyam—should be spoken; na ca—nor; mām yaḥ abhyasūyati—to one who cavils at / is envious of Me.
verses.translation: This confidential wisdom should never be spoken by you to one who is devoid of austerity, nor to one who lacks devotion, nor to one who has no desire to listen, nor to anyone who cavils at and is envious of Me.
verses.meaning: Sacred wisdom must be protected from cynical mockery: It should be shared only with earnest seekers whose hearts are open to reverence and self-transformation.
verses.purport: Sacred wisdom must be protected from cynical mockery: It should be shared only with earnest seekers whose hearts are open to reverence and self-transformation.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति |
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः || ६८ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति |
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः || ६८ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati |
bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ || 68 ||
verses.word_meanings: yaḥ—whoever; idam—this; paramam guhyam—supreme confidential secret; mad-bhakteṣu—among My devotees; abhidhāsyati—shall teach / expound; bhaktim mayi parām kṛtvā—having performed supreme devotion unto Me; mām eva eṣyati—shall certainly attain Me; asaṃśayaḥ—without any doubt.
verses.translation: Whoever imparts this supreme confidential wisdom to My devotees, performing the highest devotion unto Me, shall without doubt attain Me.
verses.meaning: Sharing the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita is declared by Sri Krishna to be the highest practical expression of devotion, guaranteeing liberation.
verses.purport: Sharing the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita is declared by Sri Krishna to be the highest practical expression of devotion, guaranteeing liberation.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः |
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि || ६९ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः |
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि || ६९ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ |
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi || 69 ||
verses.word_meanings: na ca—nor; tasmāt—than him; manuṣyeṣu—among human beings; kaścit—anyone; me—to Me; priya-kṛt-tamaḥ—who renders more pleasing service; bhavitā—there shall be; na ca—nor; me—to Me; tasmāt—than him; anyaḥ—another; priyataraḥ—more beloved; bhuvi—on this earth.
verses.translation: There is none among human beings who renders more pleasing service to Me than he, nor shall there be anyone on this entire earth more beloved to Me than he.
verses.meaning: The teacher and transmitter of the Gita holds the dearest place in the heart of Bhagavan Sri Krishna.
verses.purport: The teacher and transmitter of the Gita holds the dearest place in the heart of Bhagavan Sri Krishna.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः |
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः || ७० ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः |
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः || ७० ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ |
jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ || 70 ||
verses.word_meanings: adhyeṣyate—shall study / recite; ca—and; yaḥ—whoever; imam—this; dharmyam—sacred / righteous; saṃvādam—dialogue; āvayoḥ—of ours (Krishna and Arjuna); jñāna-yajñena—through the sacrifice of wisdom (Jnana Yajna); tena—by him; aham—I; iṣṭaḥ syām—shall have been worshipped; iti me matiḥ—such is My conviction.
verses.translation: And whoever shall study this sacred dialogue of ours shall have worshipped Me through the sacrifice of wisdom (Jñāna-yajña). Such is My conviction.
verses.meaning: Reading, contemplating, and studying the Gita is itself a profound sacrifice of wisdom that directly connects the seeker with the Lord.
verses.purport: Reading, contemplating, and studying the Gita is itself a profound sacrifice of wisdom that directly connects the seeker with the Lord.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः |
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् || ७१ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः |
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् || ७१ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ |
so'pi muktaḥ śubhām̐llokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām || 71 ||
verses.word_meanings: śraddhāvān—endowed with faith; anasūyaḥ ca—and free from envy/malice; śṛṇuyāt api—even simply listens; yaḥ naraḥ—whatever person; saḥ api—that person too; muktaḥ—liberated from evil; śubhān lokān—the auspicious realms; prāpnuyāt—shall attain; puṇya-karmaṇām—of the righteous.
verses.translation: Even the person who simply listens to this dialogue with faith and free from envy shall be liberated and attain the auspicious realms of the righteous.
verses.meaning: Even the humble listener who hears the Gita with sincerity and reverence absorbs purifying spiritual vibrations and achieves auspicious elevation.
verses.purport: Even the humble listener who hears the Gita with sincerity and reverence absorbs purifying spiritual vibrations and achieves auspicious elevation.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा |
कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय || ७२ ||
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा |
कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय || ७२ ||
verses.transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca |
kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā |
kaccidajñānasammohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya || 72 ||
verses.word_meanings: kaccit—has it been; etat—this; śrutam—heard; pārtha—O Partha; tvayā—by you; ekāgreṇa cetasā—with a one-pointed focused mind; kaccit—has; ajñāna-sammohaḥ—the delusion born of ignorance; pranaṣṭaḥ te—been completely dispelled for you; dhanañjaya—O Dhananjaya (Arjuna).
verses.translation: O Partha! Have you listened to this teaching with a one-pointed, focused mind? Has your delusion born of ignorance been completely dispelled, O Dhananjaya?
verses.meaning: Sri Krishna concludes His grand discourse as the supreme Guru, tenderly checking with Arjuna whether the light of wisdom has shattered the darkness of his initial despondency.
verses.purport: Sri Krishna concludes His grand discourse as the supreme Guru, tenderly checking with Arjuna whether the light of wisdom has shattered the darkness of his initial despondency.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन उवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच |
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत |
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव || ७३ ||
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच |
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत |
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव || ७३ ||
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca |
naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta |
sthito'smi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava || 73 ||
verses.word_meanings: arjunaḥ uvāca—Arjuna said; naṣṭaḥ mohaḥ—destroyed is delusion; smṛtiḥ labdhā—memory of my true spiritual nature has been regained; tvat-prasādāt—by Your divine grace; mayā—by me; acyuta—O Infallible One; sthitaḥ asmi—I stand firm / resolute; gata-sandehaḥ—with all doubts dispelled; kariṣye—I shall execute; vacanam tava—Your divine word/command.
verses.translation: Arjuna said: Destroyed is my delusion! I have regained memory of my true nature through Your grace, O Infallible One (Acyuta). I stand firm, with all doubts cleaved away. I will act according to Your word!
verses.meaning: Arjuna's glorious response marks the complete victory of the Gita: Grief and paralysis dissolve into clarity, strength, and surrendered obedience to the Divine Will.
verses.purport: Arjuna's glorious response marks the complete victory of the Gita: Grief and paralysis dissolve into clarity, strength, and surrendered obedience to the Divine Will.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय उवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः |
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् || ७४ ||
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः |
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् || ७४ ||
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca |
ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam || 74 ||
verses.word_meanings: sañjayaḥ uvāca—Sanjaya said; iti—thus; aham—I; vāsudevasya—of Sri Krishna; pārthasya ca—and of Arjuna; mahā-ātmanaḥ—the high-souled; saṃvādam imam—this dialogue; aśrauṣam—have heard; adbhutam—wondrous; roma-harṣaṇam—causing hair to stand on end / thrilling with ecstasy.
verses.translation: Sañjaya said: Thus have I heard this wondrous, thrilling dialogue between Vāsudeva (Sri Krishna) and the high-souled Pārtha (Arjuna), which makes my hair stand on end in ecstasy.
verses.meaning: Sanjaya speaks to King Dhritarashtra, expressing the overwhelming awe and spiritual ecstasy of having listened to this immortal cosmic dialogue.
verses.purport: Sanjaya speaks to King Dhritarashtra, expressing the overwhelming awe and spiritual ecstasy of having listened to this immortal cosmic dialogue.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय उवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् |
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् || ७५ ||
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् |
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् || ७५ ||
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca |
vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param |
yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam || 75 ||
verses.word_meanings: vyāsa-prasādāt—by the grace of sage Vedavyasa; śrutavān—have heard; etat—this; guhyam—confidential; aham—I; param—supreme; yogam—Yoga; yogeśvarāt kṛṣṇāt—from the Lord of Yoga, Sri Krishna; sākṣāt—directly; kathayataḥ svayam—speaking Himself in person.
verses.translation: By the grace of the sage Vyāsa I have heard this supreme, most confidential Yoga directly from the Lord of Yoga, Sri Krishna Himself, speaking in person.
verses.meaning: Sanjaya acknowledges his guru Vedavyasa, whose divine vision enabled him to witness and hear the entire Gita live from Sri Krishna.
verses.purport: Sanjaya acknowledges his guru Vedavyasa, whose divine vision enabled him to witness and hear the entire Gita live from Sri Krishna.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय उवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् |
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः || ७६ ||
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् |
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः || ७६ ||
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca |
rājaṅsaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam |
keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ || 76 ||
verses.word_meanings: rājan—O King (Dhritarashtra); saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya—remembering repeatedly; saṃvādam imam adbhutam—this wondrous dialogue; keśava-arjunayoḥ—between Keshava and Arjuna; puṇyam—sacred/holy; hṛṣyāmi ca—I rejoice and thrill; muhuḥ muhuḥ—again and again at every moment.
verses.translation: O King! Remembering again and again this wondrous and holy dialogue between Keśava and Arjuna, I rejoice and thrill with bliss at every moment.
verses.meaning: Contemplating the Gita generates endless waves of spiritual joy that deepen with every remembrance.
verses.purport: Contemplating the Gita generates endless waves of spiritual joy that deepen with every remembrance.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय उवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः |
विस्मयो मे महान्राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः || ७७ ||
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः |
विस्मयो मे महान्राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः || ७७ ||
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca |
tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ |
vismayo me mahānrājan hṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ || 77 ||
verses.word_meanings: tat ca—and that; saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya—remembering again and again; rūpam ati-adbhutam—most wondrous cosmic form (Vishvarupa); hareḥ—of Lord Hari (Sri Krishna); vismayaḥ me mahān—great is my amazement/wonder; rājan—O King; hṛṣyāmi ca—and I rejoice; punaḥ punaḥ—repeatedly / over and over.
verses.translation: And remembering again and again that most wondrous cosmic form (Viśvarūpa) of Lord Hari, great is my boundless amazement, O King, and I rejoice over and over again!
verses.meaning: The memory of the infinite Universal Form revealed in Chapter 11 fills Sanjaya with perpetual wonder and transcendent joy.
verses.purport: The memory of the infinite Universal Form revealed in Chapter 11 fills Sanjaya with perpetual wonder and transcendent joy.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय उवाच
verses.text_sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः |
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम || ७८ ||
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः |
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम || ७८ ||
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca |
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ |
tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama || 78 ||
verses.word_meanings: yatra—wherever; yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ—the Lord of Yoga, Sri Krishna; yatra—wherever; pārthaḥ dhanur-dharaḥ—Partha (Arjuna), the wielder of the bow; tatra—there; śrīḥ—eternal prosperity/fortune; vijayaḥ—victory; bhūtiḥ—extraordinary expansion/splendor; dhruvā nītiḥ—unshakeable righteousness/justice; matiḥ mama—such is my firm conviction.
verses.translation: Wherever there is Sri Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, and wherever there is Pārtha (Arjuna), the wielder of the bow, there will surely be eternal prosperity, victory, extraordinary splendor, and firm righteousness. This is my firm conviction.
verses.meaning: The crowning prophecy of the Gita: When divine grace (Yogeshvara Krishna) and human dedication (Dhanurdhara Arjuna) unite in righteous action, ultimate victory, prosperity, and moral order are eternally assured.
verses.purport: The crowning prophecy of the Gita: When divine grace (Yogeshvara Krishna) and human dedication (Dhanurdhara Arjuna) unite in righteous action, ultimate victory, prosperity, and moral order are eternally assured.
